phase: Phase 5 - approved adaptive collection, integrity and chain of custody
purpose: Safely increase the collection priority only when a documented, approved rule observes attributed controlled traffic. Preserve each registered source through SHA-256 hashing, complete custody metadata and immediate retrieval verification without altering the original source artifact.

action.description: Prioritise the slice-specific traffic, UE-session and control-plane evidence references for the attributed slice.

rules.rationale: A labelled, attributed controlled-traffic observation is the approved laboratory signal for a load-related collection-priority update. Shared and unattributed records do not trigger this rule.
